Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is it from this one-sided affair. On the 18th of this month, Group A action see, Namibia will take on Netherlands at 9.30 am IST (4 am GMT) and later, Sri Lanka will face United Arab Emirates at 1.30 pm IST (8 am GMT). Do join us for the build up. Till then, cheers!

Craig Ervine, the skipper of Zimbabwe says they are happy and feels they belong here on the big stage. Applauds the performance of Sikandar Raza, says he is their best batter from the past few months. Tells they learned from the Ireland innings and they went a bit fuller. Reckons run rate could be possibly in the end and they are disappointed for dropping a few catches in the back end.

Andy Balbirnie says he has no regret at all. Adds he was happy at halfway with the ball but Raza took the game away. On Josh Little, he is their strike bowler. On their batting, Andy Balbirnie says Zimbabwe bowled brilliantly. They wanted to play decent cricket but they will look to turn things around now.

Sikandar Raza is the Player of the Match. He says he and Sean Williams tried to take the stand till the deep. Adds he just tried to time the ball well. Shares the wicket got harder or he just got a bit tired in middle. Reckons there is no secret to success. Says try and channel all the emotions of success and failure into the right way and try to compete with the best in the world. Shares there is a bit of discomfort but he hopes that he will be ready for the next game. Tells that their goal is to qualify for the next round. Reckons he will not celebrate this victory as he wants to go more further in the tournament.
...Presentation coming up...

Earlier, it was the masterclass from Sikandar Raza that proved to be the match-winning one. His innings made Zimbabwe get past 170. In reply, Zimbabwe bowlers reacted brilliantly and Ireland had no chance at all to chase the score.

Ireland were off to the worst start possible as they lost four in six overs and since then it was really hard for them to get back on track. There were a couple of partnerships but none that took the required run rate down. Ireland will hope for a better performance with the bat in this tournament. It was a batting pitch but Ireland failed to play that anchor role.

A comfortable win in the end for Zimbabwe! A good performance overall from them and it feels, that Raza's performance made a real difference. The bowlers then took four wickets inside the Powerplay and then kept a lid on the run flow. They kept on taking wickets at regular intervals and didn't give a single chance for Ireland to get back in the game. Blessing Muzarabani was the pick of the bowler as he claimed three wickets while Tendai Chatara and Richard Ngarava ended with two each. Zimbabwe were untidy at the backend but the victory was never in doubt.
Short ball on middle. Little looks to play to third man but misses. Zimbabwe win by 31 runs.
A slower bumper on middle. Little lets it go.
FOUR! A length ball, outside off. Little slaps it hard through covers for a boundary. These runs will make a difference eventually in the net run rate.
On a length and outside off. Little shuffles to paddle it but misses.
Short again. Little fails to connect his bat.
Short in length and on middle. Little looks to ramp it away but misses.
SIX! Ireland are not giving away still! Tad short and outside off. McCarthy pulls it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
On middle on a length. Little flicks it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Short of a length and outside off. McCarthy pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slower ball again. McCarthy looks to heave but misses.
A slower full ball, outside off. McCarthy swings and misses.
FOUR LEG BYES! Zimbabwe are untidy at the backend! Short in length and on off. McCarthy looks to pull but misses. It goes off his body and past the diving keeper to third man.
The wait continues for Zimbabwe! Touch short and on middle. McCarthy again mistimes his pull. The ball goes to deep square leg where the fielder runs in but fails to judge the flight of the ball.
FOUR! This is full and on leg. McCarthy makes room and lofts it straight down for a boundary.
Short ball on middle. McCarthy looks to pull but misses.
Outside off, played to third man for a single.
Outside off. Little has a wild swing and misses.

Zimbabwe have to wait a bit more! Short and on middle. McCarthy looks to pull but gets a top edge. It goes high and to square leg. The keeper calls and dives but fails to pouch it cleanly. A single. Was just away from his reach.
A full toss on middle. McCarthy pulls it to deep mid-wicket who collects on a bounce. One more.
Outside off, punched to covers for one.
Length ball, outside off. McCarthy pulls it to deep square leg for one.
SIX! THAT IS CLEAN! Fuller ball, outside off, slower one. McCarthy slogs it high over mid-wicket for a biggie.
This is full and outside off, driven to mid off.
Short in length and around off. McCarthy comes down the track as he swings across but misses. It goes over the stumps.
On a length and on middle. Blocked out.
Josh Little walks out.

OUT! TAKEN! This is full and outside off. Mark Adair makes room and spoons it to backward point. Sikandar Raza dives forward and takes a low catch. A good slow ball from Blessing Muzarabani who gets his second wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Sikandar Raza b Blessing Muzarabani

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and way outside off. Adair looks to drive but misses.
SIX! BIGGIE! Short and on off. Adair pulls it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
No ball! On middle. McCarthy flicks it to deep square leg. Blessing Muzarabani has overstepped and a free hit will follow.
Follows Adair on the leg side, this is hit to long on for a single.
Full ball, outside off. Adair looks to go inside-out but misses.
A length ball on middle. McCarthy blocks it out solidly.
Barry McCarthy is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Tendai Chatara gets another one! This is full and just outside off. Singh looks to drive it away but gets an inside edge and it ricochets onto the off pole. What a performance this is from Zimbabwe. Tendai Chatara is on a Hat-trick.

OUT! TAKEN! Zimbabwe are edging closer! Tendai Chatara rolls his finger on this length ball. This is on off. Gareth Delany hits it high and to long on where Milton Shumba takes the skier. A poor shot and Delany has to go.
Commentary.Howout: c Milton Shumba b Tendai Chatara

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on middle. Adair whips it behind square leg for one.
On middle, this is hit to deep mid-wicket for a single.

This is on a length and outside off, it lands and nips back in sharply. Gareth Delany looks to shack it but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW but nothing given. Zimbabwe take the review but the replay shows the ball goes past the wicket.
This is full and around leg. Adair makes room to drive but misses.
On middle, Gareth Delany flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single. 100 up!
Bye! This is outside off. Adair looks to drive but misses. The keeper fails to stop and it goes behind for a bye.
Flatter, slower and on middle. Adair pushes it back to Raza.
A single as this is hit to long on.
FOUR! Much needed! Tossed up, outside off. Gareth Delany lofts it over the bowler's head for four.
Tossed up on off. Gareth Delany smacks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, played back to the bowler.
Flatter and outside off. Adair slaps it to deep point for one.

OUT! TIMBER! Another partnership is broken! Zimbabwe back on top! This is very full and angling on middle. Campher goes way across the line to sweep and fails to connect the ball. The stumps are disturbed.
Short and outside off, Campher slaps it to sweeper cover for a brace.
Around off, pushed through covers for one.
Flat and on off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, kept out.
SIX! A welcome and a much needed boundary! Flighted full and on middle. Gareth Delany launches it over long on and clears the big fence.
Very full and on off, this is hit to long on for a single.
Wide! Way down the leg side. Campher misses his sweep.
Length ball, outside off. Gareth Delany slaps it to long off for a single.
THREE RUNS! Tossed up on off. Campher scoops it over short fine leg now.
On off, this is driven to the left of long off for a brace.
Tossed up, on off. Gareth Delany slog-sweeps it. The fielder makes an excellent stop as he flicks the ball away from the ropes for a couple.
Short and outside off, cut hard to deep cover for one.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
On middle. Campher reverse sweeps it to point. Only one.
Tossed up on middle. Gareth Delany drives it to long on for a single.
Two runs now as Campher hits this full ball to deep mid-wicket.
A single as this is hit to long on.
Outside off. Gareth Delany looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
This is full and outside off. Gareth Delany looks to drive but misses.

OUT! TIMBER! Sikandar Raza with the ball now! What a day he is having. Surely, George Dockrell didn't see thins coming. A yorker from Raza, right at the base of middle. George Dockrell is late to get his bat down and it goes through and hits the stumps. Ireland now need 111 runs in 64 balls with 5 wickets in hand.
FLatter and outside off. Dockrell chops it on the off side.
Outside off, guided through point for a couple.
MISFIELD AND FOUR! A slower full ball, outside off. Curtis Campher steps across and paddles it to square leg. The fielder gets low and lets it through his hands for a boundary.
Full and on off, pushed to the right of extra cover. Good diving stop. A single.
Very full and on middle, flicked behind square on the leg side for one.
Full and outside off. It goes again off the outside edge, this time over point for a single.
FOUR! A slip could have helped Zimbabwe! Fuller ball on middle. Dockrell looks to heave but gets an outside edge and it flies to third man for four.
Tossed up, outside off. Curtis Campher sweeps it to deep square leg. Good fielding in the deep.
A single as this is hit to sweeper cover.
Outside off. Dockrell hits hard, it goes more off the upper half and over point for a couple.
Touch short, this is hit to point for a single.
Around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Flatter and targeting off. Dockrell slaps it to cover for one.
Around off, blocked out.
Short ball on middle. Dockrell pulls it wide of deep square leg. The fielder runs to his right and slides. Two runs.
On middle, nudged to mid-wicket for one.
Fuller ball, outside off, swinging away. Dockrell pushes it to cover for one.
FOUR! Two in a row! On the hips, it is clipped to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Length ball, outside off. Dockrell looks to push but gets an outside edge past the keeper to third man for a boundary.
Length ball on middle. Dockrell works it to square leg for one. What a Powerplay for Zimbabwe. Ireland are reeling on 33/4. They need 142 runs in 84 balls.
Outside off, steered to third man for a single.
Excellent stuff from the bowler! On a length and outside off. Curtis Campher defends inside the line and misses.
On the hips, clipped to deep square leg for one.
Ohh! That was a ripper! Short again on middle. Dockrell did well to get his head away. That was a brilliant delivery.
That took off. Short and outside off. Dockrell looks to swing but misses.
Outside off, dabbed to point for one.
Short in length and on middle. Curtis Campher skips down and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Around off, pushed to point.
Length ball, outside off. Dockrell punches, the fielder at cover half-stops and a single is taken.
Wide! Down the leg side again. Wided.
On middle, this is hit to mid-wicket for one.
2 Wides! Down the leg side. Dockrell misses his pull. The keeper gets a hand on it and a single is taken.
Length and outside off, punched to cover.
Leg bye! On the pads, George Dockrell fends it on the leg side for a quick leg bye.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Second time in the over but this time it is Ireland's skipper who has to depart. Fantastic from Blessing Muzarabani! Extra bounce and pace from him. This is short in length and just outside the off pole. Andy Balbirnie has a feel for it, tries to push but gets an outside edge and Craig Ervine this time takes the catch to his left at first slip.
Commentary.Howout: c Craig Ervine b Blessing Muzarabani

Commentary.Commentary: A quick single as this is pushed to mid on.
Full ball, outside off. Curtis Campher looks to push but it goes off the  outside edge to third man for a brace.
Curtis Campher comes in.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Blessing Muzarabani strikes in his first over! This is on a length and outside off, it nips away a touch. Harry Tector looks to push but gets an outside edge and it goes to Craig Ervine at first slip. Ireland are in real trouble. Three down now.
Commentary.Howout: c Craig Ervine b Blessing Muzarabani

Commentary.Commentary: Four leg byes! Too straight on the pads. Harry Tector misses his clip and it goes off the pads to fine leg for four.
Outside off, dabbed to backward point for one.
A bouncer to Tector who evades it well.
Harry Tector is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! PLAYED ALL OVER IT! Lorcan Tucker shuffles way across here. This is on a length and on middle. He misses his wild swing across the line and the ball hits the stumps. Two for Richard Ngarava now.
On middle, dabbed to backward point for a single.
Richard Ngarava drops it short and on middle. Balbirnie looks to pull but gets a top edge behind the keeper for a couple of runs.
On off, kept out.
A big outswinger, length and outside off. Lorcan Tucker skips down and looks to smash it but misses.
Outside off, tapped to point.
Tendai Chatara makes it to swing away! This is on a length, outside off. Lorcan Tucker looks to drive but misses.
FOUR! Well played! On a length and outside off. Lorcan Tucker shuffles way across and scoops it over fine leg for a boundary.
Bit of movement in the air! This is full and on middle, swinging away. Lorcan Tucker uses his feet to keep it out.
A length ball, outside off. Lorcan Tucker looks to push but misses.
Tendai Chatara to start from the other end.
DROP AND RUN! Length ball on off. Lorcan Tucker blocks on the deck. Andy Balbirnie calls for a single and makes the other end.
FOUR! THAT WAS VERY CLOSE! On a length and on middle. Lorcan Tucker leans to defend but gets an inside edge past the leg stump and to fine leg for four runs.
A length ball, outside off. Lorcan Tucker takes the aerial route as he hits over covers but slices and it falls safely. Two runs. Ireland are underway.
On middle on a length, Lorcan Tucker defends it out.
Lorcan Tucker comes in next.

OUT! BOWLED! What a start for Zimbabwe! This is short in length and outside off. Paul Stirling gets on his toes as he looks to punch but the inward movement takes the inside edge and the ball deflects and hits the stumps. Just what Zimbabwe wanted! The big wicket of the power-hitter.
On a length and on middle. Paul Stirling defends it out.
